title: Darium ore
body:
![darium](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aeee908ca011d9d67a6369cf7a2b047d58323b03.png)
 
Darium is a stronger and better (but still kinda fair, considering Netherite is) material than Netherite

However it doesnt protect You from burn damage!


The ore is rare (On avarege 2 pieces a chunk!)
And needing a diamond pickaxe to mine making it endgame


The mod adds only a few things such as:

The basic 5 tools (Sword, Axe, Pickaxe, Hoe, Shovel)


![tools](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/df62981599107e8355f646e93b01fabce77fafdc.webp)


-An Ore and dust
-A Block


![ore and dust](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ae589805861a0b7f32983a60800c06cf3bf388a.webp)


-And lastly the armour


![armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4b4f3bcdac766f110f0141e884e2bd6c3662a0d6.webp)


Everything is craftable as in the normal game

This is a very light mod so should be able to fit in any modpack!

For now Forge only

1.18.2 (Only verison for now)

Made with MCreator
